# MAL advisory fixtures

`MAL-2025-46969.json` captures the OpenSSF Malicious Packages record for chalk 5.6.1.
Source: https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/MAL-2025-46969
Upstream: https://github.com/ossf/malicious-packages/blob/main/osv/malicious/npm/chalk/MAL-2025-46969.json
Retrieved: 2026-10-11. SHA-256: `ccc893ebda668333c7c01122867aaa4fd1711c56f8bcdec0e79fcca06846d992`.
The OpenSSF project distributes its records under Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE`.

`maliciousZip` derives labelled fixture records by changing the primary ID, affected
package, ecosystem, versions, and optional withdrawal date. These variants make no
claim about the named package in a public registry. The original record stays active
as a nonempty control. All installed npm and wheel fixtures contain inert test bytes.
